blocks.text: Una caught up on a few projects she’s wrapped.

Oh, the Redfern Hill signs are finally up! They’re these great solid rectangles—I used old timber from a shed deconstruction over in the North Market. Painted the background a deep mossy green so the bright white lettering just pops. ‘Parking’ with a big arrow, ‘Produce’ with a little carrot shape. Very clear, very sturdy. The market manager said they’ve already cut down on people wandering into the delivery lane.
Noted. And the other thing was for Bluebell Crossing?

Yes, the welcome packets! I wanted something warm, not just a stack of papers. So it’s a little folder in sunny yellow, with a winding path illustration on the front—like a journey, you know? Inside, the daily schedule is a timeline with soft blue blocks for nap time and these little orange circles for snack breaks. The emergency contact page has friendly, rounded icons by each name. I dropped off fifty sets last week. The coordinator told me parents have been mentioning how much easier it is to show the picture schedule to their little ones.
